description: This file defines the 'LoanAccrualActivityRepository' interface, which extends Spring Data's 'Repository' to provide custom database query methods related to loan accrual activities within the Fineract project. It includes a single method with a complex JPQL query to fetch loan IDs eligible for accrual activity posting based on various loan and transaction criteria.

classes.name: LoanAccrualActivityRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data repository interface for accessing loan accrual activity data, providing custom query methods based on JPQL.

methods.name: fetchLoanIdsForAccrualActivityPosting
methods.description: Executes a JPQL query to fetch IDs of loans that are eligible for accrual activity posting, based on loan, transaction, and schedule conditions.
